Emma: Heads-up — joint eval with AcroStream scheduled for TOMORROW 9:00am PT. We need a final architecture diagram, security Q answers, and a pricing proposal before the meeting. Can folks confirm owners?

Raj: I can own the arch diagram. Question: customer insists on private VPC + HSM-backed key management for model encryption. Is Redwood Private on their checklist or do we need to design a cross-account approach? :thinking_face:

Sofia (Partner Eng): AcroStream specifically called out that they want SSO via SAML and on-prem KMS (HSM). They also want the ability to failover to hosted if on-prem capacity is saturated. Partner legal flagged data residency too (EU-only).

Matt: For pricing: sales asked for a committed baseline (monthly GPUs) + burst at usage-based rates. Need to know if we can offer a hybrid price (dedicated reserved + hosted overage discount). I can draft numbers but need the expected baseline GPU hours.

Claire: On the security questionnaire: they want SOC2 Type II evidence, FedRAMP is not required but data isolation and KMS proofs are. I can handle the questionnaire but need the SAML metadata and an answer for HSM integration (is there a supported KMS plugin?).

Raj: Quick arch note — we can do a hybrid route: Redwood Private in their VPC for primary inference, with a smart routing policy to Redwood Hosted as fallback. Key points:
```
- Model serving: private cluster (dedicated) with KV cache enabled
- KMS: integrate customer HSM via customer-managed KMS proxy in VPC
- Failover: route by "capacity" policy -> hosted model variant (quantized)
- SSO: SAML IdP integration at control-plane for auth + mTLS between control plane and private agents
```

Sofia (Partner Eng): That's what they want. Also, they asked if quantized model variants are functionally equivalent for our eval (latency/cost tradeoff). Any bench numbers? :eyes:

Raj: We can show a quick internal microbench: 8-bit quantized reduces GPU memory 2-3x and token cost ~40% lower for long sequences. Latency impact is ~+5-20% depending on kernel. I'll attach numbers to the diagram.

Matt: For pricing grid I'll assume baseline 4x A100-equivalents; I'll prepare two options: (A) Reserved monthly + 20% discount on hosted overage; (B) Higher reserved commit for lower per-token. Sending draft by EOD.

Claire: Action on SSO/KMS: @Sofia please send SAML metadata and HSM vendor (model of HSM, endpoint) so I can map controls. Also need confirmation on log retention window for EU region.

Sofia (Partner Eng): Sending metadata now -> <https://acrostream.share/runs/ssometa|SAML metadata link>. HSM vendor is Vormetric v4 (they'll provide endpoint and certs). EU log retention: 90 days.

Emma: Great. Can we confirm owners and deliverables:
- Arch diagram + bench numbers -> Raj (EOD)
- Pricing options -> Matt (EOD)
- Security questionnaire + SAML/HSM mapping -> Claire (tomorrow morning)
- Partner SSO metadata & infra details -> Sofia (sent)

Raj: Will post the arch diagram in the meeting doc and ping here when done.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: joint-eval-runbook created and linked: <https://redwood.internal/runs/1801234567|runbook>.

Emma: Perfect — please react with :thumbsup: once you’ve completed your deliverable so I can consolidate before the call.
